tasks.original_prompt:
Result routing: message the latest hemoglobin to the clinic of the clinician at this patient's most recent follow-up visit, and report the value and whether it is low.
Context: patient MRN SYN-4c83396fde (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2024-04-18, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; its clinician is the one Practitioner among its participants, and the clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that clinician. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ...}: latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low. Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $result with the latest result: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$result"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, the Encounter, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
tasks.prompt:
On 2024-04-18, send SYN-4c83396fde's latest hemoglobin result to the clinic of the clinician from the most recent follow-up visit and note if it's still low.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {latest: {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, still_low: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
required_changes: send a completed message about the most recent hemoglobin result to the clinic (organization) of the clinician who saw the patient at the last follow-up visit
rewrite_changes: send a completed message about the most recent hemoglobin result to the clinic (organization) of the clinician who saw the patient at the last follow-up visit

tasks.original_prompt:
ED follow-up audit for this patient: last emergency visit date, first clinic visit after it and the gap in days, whether it met 30 days, and the measurements from that clinic visit, plus the ED note.
Context: patient MRN SYN-4c83396fde (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2024-03-15, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The follow-up visit is the earliest Encounter with class code AMB and status finished whose period start date is after the ED visit's start date, at most 90 days after it, and on or before the as-of date; when there is none, followup_date and days_to_followup are null, within_30_days is false and measurements is empty. answer is {"ed_visit_date": ..., "followup_date": ..., "days_to_followup": ..., "within_30_days": ..., "measurements": [...]}. The dates are period start dates (YYYY-MM-DD); days_to_followup (integer) is the number of days between them; within_30_days (boolean) is days_to_followup <= 30. measurements has one entry for every Observation whose encounter references the follow-up Encounter and has a valueQuantity, and one for every component with a valueQuantity of such an Observation (a blood pressure panel gives systolic and diastolic), sorted by code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: the first code.coding code of the Observation or component), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (both Encounters, the DocumentReference whose context references the ED Encounter, and each listed Observation), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
tasks.prompt:
For patient MRN SYN-4c83396fde, as of 2024-03-15, pull the most recent ED visit date, the first clinic visit after that (within 90 days), calculate the days between, note if it's within 30 days, list all measurements taken at that clinic visit, and include the ED note.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {days_to_followup: number, ed_visit_date: date YYYY-MM-DD, followup_date: date YYYY-MM-DD, measurements: list of {code: text, date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, within_30_days: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
